description: Shared capability-routing manifest (Judge→Builder). Judge reports facts + defect type; Builder chooses the fixing mechanism. emit-judge-defects.mjs + defect-contract.mjs stamp category/detector/requiredMode/confidence. Uncertain root cause → replan — never default unknown findings to CSS/style.

defaultRoute.remedy: uncertain root cause — replan; never guess with CSS

traps.judgeProbe: composed-audit.mjs font probe — FontFaceSet vs plan font families
traps.builderRemedy: font-verify-and-fit shim — load real @font-face or documented web fallback; see knowledge/mock-fidelity.json
layout CSS (gap/margin/padding) on measured elements — merge sibling spacing symptoms; re-measure, don't only screenshot

traps.judgeProbe: subtle paint probes — shadow, border token, ring, hover background
traps.builderRemedy: style/paint CSS from plan tokens — not structure edits
inspect DOM parent-child/order; move Reply inside ThreadCard — never CSS to fake containment
inspect wireframe/template source; correct slots/components/nesting — never CSS to imitate a missing component

traps.judgeProbe: CONTRACT_PROBE mount-map diff (MISSING / CONTAINMENT / CARDINALITY / PHANTOM_INTERACTIVE)
traps.builderRemedy: structure build: mount the missing Velt part / fix containment — never a CSS patch
run interaction flow; fix event/state/reveal logic — not a static screenshot-only CSS guess
mechanism CSS / host wiring per knowledge/mechanism-polish.json — confirm not structure first
NONE for Builder — planner ticket; style planner re-derives
NONE for Builder — planner ticket; structure planner revises

traps.judgeProbe: composed-audit visual-diff regions with no named vision miss
traps.builderRemedy: P1 only — re-glance and NAME the miss before prescribing a fix; never guess CSS
